home.title: Your voice, our news.
home.lead: Seen a problem in your village or town? Tell us.
home.quickSub: Type or take a photo · 1 minute
home.step1: no name needed. You get a number right away.
home.step2: HTP Khabar journalists check if it is true.
home.step3: issues that matter to the public are published.
home.notice: Not every report becomes news. Your exact location and phone number are never made public.
home.demo: Demo version — please don't send real reports.

report.whatPh: Describe it briefly, or speak below
report.title: Title
report.urgentSub: Someone's life or safety is at risk right now
report.whereAddSub: GPS, map or choose yourself · optional
report.video: I have a video. HTP Khabar can call me to get it.
report.videoNeedsContact: For video we need a phone or email.
report.name: Name
report.contactHint: Give a phone or an email. It is never published.
report.contactRequired: Add a phone or an email
report.anonNote: Even without a name, you can check your report with its number and link.
report.consent: The information I gave is true. I understand not every report becomes news.
report.fixErrors: Please check the parts marked in red above.
report.failed: Couldn't send. Check your internet and tap again. What you wrote is saved.

emergency.title: Call first
emergency.body: If someone is in danger now, call right away. Then tell HTP Khabar too.
emergency.htpSub: After you send the report, you can send all the details to WhatsApp in one tap.
emergency.privacy: Sending on WhatsApp shows your phone number to HTP Khabar.
emergency.noAuto: This website does not alert the police by itself — please call.

wa.voiceNote: Voice recording sent on the website.

voice.limit: You can speak up to {{min}} minutes
voice.denied: Microphone permission was denied. Allow it in settings, or type instead.
voice.unsupported: Recording isn't supported in this browser. Type your report instead.

location.title: Where did it happen?
location.denied: Location permission denied. No problem — pick on the map or choose yourself.
location.unavailable: Couldn't find your location. Pick on the map or choose yourself.
location.search: Name of a place, chowk or village
location.noResult: Not found. Place the pin on the map.
location.drag: Tap the map or drag the red pin to the spot.
location.outside: This place's municipality isn't in the demo list — choose below.
location.wardHint: The map finds the municipality; choose the ward yourself.
location.ok1: You can report even without a location.
location.ok2: Your exact location is never made public.

done.title: Report received
done.thanks: Thank you. HTP Khabar will look at it.
done.keepBody: You need this link to see where your report is. The number alone won't open it. The link won't be shown again.
done.qrHint: Take a photo of this QR — scan it later to see your report.
done.saved: Saved on this phone — find it under "My report".
done.next2: If we need more, we ask through this link.
done.missing: The link isn't shown again when this page reopens. Look under "My report".

track.title: My report
track.nonePhone: No reports have been sent from this phone yet.
track.other: Sent from another phone? Enter the number and code
track.codeHint: Filled in automatically if you open your link.
track.notFound: Number or code didn't match. Please check again.
track.desc_received: Your report has reached HTP Khabar.
track.desc_closed: Work on this report is finished.
track.next_received: Next: a journalist reads it and starts checking.
track.next_under_review: Next: once checked, HTP decides whether it becomes news.
track.storyOut: A news story was published about this
track.noStory: No story was published about this. Not every report becomes news, but your information is safe with HTP Khabar.
track.request: HTP Khabar has a question for you
track.onlyStatus: Only the status is shown here. Which journalist is working on it and internal notes are never shown.

explore.title: All reports
explore.correction: Want to correct or reply to a report?
explore.mapNote: The map shows the middle of the municipality, never an exact location.

today.title: Today
today.urgent: {{n}} urgent report(s) need a look now
today.mineEmpty: Nothing is assigned to you right now.

next.label: Next step
next.waitAssign: Waiting for Admin Head to assign

d.onlyHead: Only the Admin Head can assign.
d.contactNone: The citizen stayed anonymous. No contact details exist.
d.contactHidden: The citizen shared contact details. Only the Admin Head can see them.
d.publicNote: Admins write the summary; only the Admin Head publishes. Citizen text, photos and contact are never public.
d.notePh: What you checked, who you called, what you found…

board.title: Board
board.hint: Tap the next step on a card — it moves to the next column by itself.

m.askLabel: Question shown on the citizen's tracking page
m.dupLabel: Number of the original report (e.g. HTP-2083-000120)
